title: 中国不急推大刺激：出口复苏却与汇率脱钩，价值链上移能否持续？
speaker: Kanhari Singh

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, that's a pretty good question. I think when I think about the big picture in China, and even if I go as far back as the reopening trade, the market has clearly looked for some large headlines around fiscal stimulus.
segments.zh: 这是个好问题。思考中国大局，甚至回溯到重启交易，市场明显在寻找财政刺激的大标题。

segments.en: And we did get that in terms of direct equity markets stimulus in September 2024. And you know, to us in many ways, that was China's way of kind of experimenting with trying to see if positive wealth effects can be kicked in on a consumer from a consumer perspective by supporting equity markets very strongly and broadly.
segments.zh: 2024年9月我们确实看到了直接权益市场刺激。对我们来说，这在中国很多方面是一种实验，试图通过强力广泛支持权益市场，从消费者角度激发正向财富效应。

segments.en: But when I think about 2025, we moved on to essentially price that right tail out from Chinese equity markets on fiscal stimulus.
segments.zh: 但思考2025年，我们基本上已从中国权益市场中排除财政刺激的右尾风险。

segments.en: And I think for the right reasons, you know, when we look at the economy this year, it's been a very k-shaped path for China growth is below expectations, but pockets of the economy like exports are doing exceptionally strong driven by semiconductors.
segments.zh: 我认为有合理原因。看今年经济，中国增长呈非常K型路径，低于预期，但出口等领域受半导体驱动异常强劲。

segments.en: What's been interesting is that that export recovery is somewhat decoupling from the effect strength as well, which tells you that China is moving up in the value chain of exports as well.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，出口复苏在一定程度上与汇率强势脱钩，这说明中国在出口价值链上也在上移。

segments.en: So I think from a policy perspective, there is no rush here to come in to do big fiscal stimulus and equity market support is still extremely targeted to turn things around.
segments.zh: 所以从政策角度看，并不急于推出大规模财政刺激，权益市场支持仍非常有针对性以扭转局面。
